Knowledge Base Context Builder

Turn KB research into a project context file.
SKILL · RUNS AUTOMATICALLY WHEN IT APPLIES

What it does

Transforms existing KB research modules into an uploadable project context file through a structured intake and quality gate that prevents scope drift and untraced content.

When to use it

A project needs a context file built from existing knowledge-base modules.

How to trigger it

"build a context file from [topic]"

"package the [topic] research"

"synthesize the [slug] modules"

Requirements

What this skill needs in order to run. Added 2026-08-20.

Skills - None.

Connectors / MCP servers - None.

Folder access - Read access to the KB modules named by slug, and write access to the context-file destination.

KB modules / context files - The exact KB module slugs you supply - it works from those, not from a topic description.

Repos - None.

If something is missing - A slug that does not resolve is LOUD. The SILENT failure is a partial synthesis: if some slugs resolve and others do not, the output looks complete while missing whole sources, so check every slug was found before using the file.
